issues.description: Human cluster count inconsistency: Results report 128 distinct cell identities (60 altered states), while Methods and Discussion report 159 high-quality V2 clusters. If 159 is the cluster baseline, the 128 final labels may under-represent clusters; clarify whether merged/ambiguous clusters or annotation labels account for the difference.
C-MYOF and pvMYOF: 'MYOF' is used as an abbreviation for myofibroblast, not as a gene marker; candidates 5 and 38 are excluded for this reason.
